 Live election results: Cedrick Frazier wins Hennepin County Attorney election
 By Kilat Fitzgerald FOX 9 2026 Elections Published  November 3, 2026 5:20 PM CST Share
 Copy Link 
 Email 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 LinkedIn 
 Reddit 
 Published  November 3, 2026 5:20 PM CST article 
 The Brief
 Cedrick Frazier defeated Anders Folk in the election for Hennepin County Attorney. 
 Election results began coming in after polls closed at 8 p.m. 
 The position came up for grabs following Mary Moriarty’s announcement that she would not seek reelection. 
 (FOX 9) - Cedrick Frazier defeated Anders Folk in the election for Hennepin County Attorney. 
 Folk conceded the election and Frazier thanked his supporters late Tuesday evening. 
 The position came up for grabs following Mary Moriarty’s announcement that she would not seek reelection . 
 FULL LIST: Minnesota 2026 election results 
 Hennepin County Attorney election results
 Results will start coming in after polls close at 8 p.m. Find live results below.  
 Who is Cedrick Frazier? 
 Hennepin Co. Attorney race: Conversation with candidate Frazier 
 Candidate for Hennepin County Attorney's Office, Cedrick Frazier, spoke about his vision ahead of the election and what sets him apart from his opponent, Anders Folk.
 Cedrick Frazier is serving his third term in the Minnesota House of Representatives, representing District 43A. Before joining the Legislature, he worked as a public defender in Hennepin County. 
 According to his campaign website, Frazier became the first Black person to serve on the New Hope City Council in 2018.
 Frazier secured the DFL endorsement over fellow Democrat, Anders Folk.
 Frazier's site also says he will "secure convictions and send a clear message to Trump and his agents across the country that no person is above the law," after the fatal ICE agent-involved shootings during Operation Metro Surge.
 The Source: Information in this story comes from The Associated Press' election results, campaign websites and previous FOX 9 reporting.
